question: Why must Mahāmāyā be all-pervading in producing enjoyment for souls?
premises: Mahāmāyā acts for the sake of enjoyment.
Providing enjoyment to infinite souls requires pervasiveness.
inference: Therefore Mahāmāyā is all-pervading because it produces enjoyment for infinite souls.
plain_english: Because souls are infinite, it is all-pervading and acts for the sake of their enjoyment.
